physical_boundary: Ideal projective gates only; no gate synthesis depth/rate, physical F3, detector, photonic qutrit or two-qutrit entangler demonstrated
prior_art: Single-qutrit Clifford+R gate synthesis/approximate universality exists in prior art; this is an independent exact algebraic certificate for the particular F3,R pair.
proof: Infinite order forces a nonzero identity-component Lie algebra of the compact projective closure. The Lie algebra is adjoint-invariant. The exact modular rank 63 proves scalar adjoint commutant over R, hence irreducibility (orthogonal invariant projections would otherwise commute); therefore the Lie algebra is all su(3), and the closure is PU(3).
